Get ACB Match Advanced Stats

Source: R/acb.R
acb_match_advanced_stats.Rd

Team advanced statistics of a game against the team's season and win/loss splits.

One row per team (team_side), statistic group and statistic: match_value is this game, season_value the team's season value, win_value / loss_value its values in wins / losses, *_diff the game minus that split. Groups: four_factors, game_rhythm, ball_handling, shooting, points, ratings, rebounds. All are Float64 (rates are percentages 0-100 unless the stat is a ratio, such as pointsPerPossession).

Endpoint: GET https://api2.acb.com/api/matchdata/AdvancedStats/match-advanced-stats

Usage

acb_match_advanced_stats(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

(required) ACB match id (integer), one global sequence for every competition: legacy ids (seasons up to 2019-20) sit below about 20000 (12559 = the 2005-06 final); ids from 2020-21 start around 100000 (105401 = Barca 89-86 Valencia Basket, Liga 2026-27 round 3). A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per record described above; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py acb_match_advanced_stats):

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerACB match id (one global sequence for every competition; legacy ids are below about 20000 up to 2019-20, ids from 2020-21 start around 100000). Taken from the request when the body does not name the game.
edition_idintegerSeason id (editionId) = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27). The wrappers take the END year, season.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27) = edition_id + 1936: the key the wrappers take.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game the team played: home or away (the feed lists the home team first).
team_idintegerSeason-team entry id: one club in one competition edition, NEW every season (Barca = 4467 in Liga 2026-27). Not the club: use club_id to follow a club across seasons.
club_idintegerStable ACB club id (2 = Barca, 9 = Real Madrid, 13 = Valencia Basket): the same across seasons and sponsor names, and the club_id request argument.
teamcharacterTeam name as registered for that season (sponsor names change; the club id does not).
team_abbrcharacterThree-letter team abbreviation (BAR, RMB, VBC).
groupcharacterStatistic group in snake_case (four_factors, game_rhythm, ball_handling, shooting, points, ratings, rebounds).
statcharacterStatistic in snake_case (efg_pct, orb_pct, tov_pct, f_tr = free-throw rate, possessions, pace, points_per_possession, ast_ratio, ..., net_rating, oer, der, trb_pct).
match_valuedoubleThe statistic in this game (the API's partido).
season_valuedoubleThe team's value over the season (the API's temporada).
win_valuedoubleThe team's value in its wins (the API's win).
loss_valuedoubleThe team's value in its losses (the API's loss).
season_diffdoubleGame value minus season value (temporadaDiff).
win_diffdoubleGame value minus the wins value (winDiff).
loss_diffdoubleGame value minus the losses value (lossDiff).

Details

  • Legal notice (sdv-internal-refs/acb/README.md, aviso legal of acb.com read 2026-10-12): ACEB, S.A.U. claims intellectual property in the site's databases (the EU sui generis database right) among its other content. It authorises viewing and private copies for personal or journalistic use with the source credited, and requires prior express consent for distribution, reproduction or public communication. These wrappers fetch on the user's behalf; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs the owner's decision first. robots.txt allows the paths.

  • Unofficial and unsupported: api2.acb.com is the .NET API behind acb.com and live.acb.com, not a documented public API. It needs the header X-APIKEY, a public key shipped in acb.com's bundle: the runtime sends the documented value ($ACB_API_KEY overrides it), re-reads the live bundle once on a 401, and never prints the key.

  • Seasons: the API keys a season by editionId = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27, 48 = 1983-84, the first). The wrappers take season, the END year (2027 = 2026-27), and the runtime sends editionId = season - 1936. A route that omits season serves the current edition. team_id is a season-team entry (new every season); club_id is the stable club.

  • Coverage: box scores from 1983-84 (old seasons carry only the whole-game period, quarter 0); play-by-play and shots from 2016-17 (earlier games answer empty lists, which raise hoopR_no_data). Shot coordinates come in two systems, split by match id: millimetres from the attacked basket from 2020-21 (coord_system mm), a 0-100 full-court percent grid before (grid). A game that is not finished (matchFinished false) raises hoopR_asset_fetch for the routes that report it.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404 / 204, a route whose rows are empty: an unknown id, a game outside a playoff series, play-by-play or shots before 2016-17, a club with no games that season), hoopR_bad_request (a missing, unknown or non-integer argument or a season before 1984, raised before any request; HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a key the API still rejects after one re-read of the bundle, any other non-200 after three attempts, a non-JSON or problem+json body, an error envelope or empty stub, a body for another season, round, club, player or match, a game that is not finished). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.

 acb_match_advanced_stats(match_id = 105401)
